chunks: From him, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If snow afflicts him, then let him look to the felt of his saddle, and let him perform tayammum from its dust or from something with him.

key_terms.الثَّلْجُ: snow that prevents access to normal ground

ai.seo_question: How should a person perform tayammum when the ground is covered with snow?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who is in a land covered by snow and cannot access normal earth for tayammum. It permits tayammum using dust found on the felt of the saddle or on some other thing in his possession.
